List available scan engines or persist a default choice by name or index.

## Usage

```text
kx engine [OPTIONS] [name]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `[name]` | Name, or the row number from the listing shown above |

## Global options

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--no-color` | Disable styled output |
| `-h, --help` | Show this message and exit |

## Examples

```bash
kx engine
kx engine trivy
```
